_why: App-side edits a promoted screen needs that Studio cannot express, reapplied by
promote-screen.py after every promotion so a re-promotion does not lose them.
Each entry is exact-string and the promoter FAILS if a find does not appear
exactly once: a patch that silently stops matching is worse than a loud error.
Keep these minimal; anything Studio can carry belongs in Studio.

app/(app)/reviews/builder/_option-a/page.why: The Builder's view (hub, templates, wizard, campaign, success) lives on the URL so Back closes a view and a link can open one.
app/(app)/reviews/builder/_option-a/page.find: import { Fragment, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
app/(app)/reviews/builder/_option-a/page.replace:
import { Fragment, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useUrlParam } from "@/lib/url-state";

app/(app)/reviews/builder/_option-a/page.why: Swap the view state for the URL param (declared after activeId, which it needs).
Declare the URL-backed view once activeId exists: a campaign view with no campaign (reload, shared link) lands on the hub.
